name: Qualitative Thematic Analysis V2 - Academic Domain

assignments.name: research_question
assignments.value: What are the key themes in the data?

assignments.name: domain
assignments.value: politics, international studies, geopolitics, AI governance, technology studies

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json;

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are an academic expert in qualitative thematic analysis specialising in: ' + item.domain + '.',
  'You apply rigorous qualitative research methods following ' + item.analysis_method + '.',
  'Your task is to perform open coding on the provided text chunk.',
  '',
  'RULES:',
  '- Generate granular, descriptive codes that capture the essence of the text.',
  '- Each code must include an exact verbatim quotation from the text.',
  '- Do not fabricate or paraphrase quotations — use only text that appears word-for-word in the chunk.',
  '- Code names must be in snake_case (e.g. power_dynamics, institutional_legitimacy).',
  '- Focus codes on themes relevant to: ' + item.research_question,
  '- Produce between 3 and 10 codes per chunk depending on richness of content.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema, with no additional commentary:',
  '{',
  '  "document_name": "<filename>",',
  '  "codes": [',
  '    {',
  '      "code": "<snake_case_code_name>",',
  '      "definition": "<one sentence definition of what this code captures>",',
  '      "quotation": "<exact verbatim quote from the text>",',
  '      "reasoning": "<why this quotation exemplifies this code>"',
  '    }',
  '  ]',
  '}'
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = [
  'Document: ' + item.source_name,
  'Chunk ' + (item.chunk_index + 1) + ' of ' + item.total_chunks + ':',
  '',
  item.chunk_text
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    claude_request: {
      model: item.model,
      max_tokens: 3000,
      temperature: 0,
      system: systemPrompt,
      messages: [{
        role: 'user',
        content: userPrompt
      }]
    },
    chunk_index: item.chunk_index,
    total_chunks: item.total_chunks,
    source_name: item.source_name,
    research_question: item.research_question,
    analysis_method: item.analysis_method,
    domain: item.domain,
    model: item.model,
    anthropic_api_key: item.anthropic_api_key,
    enable_ai_coding: item.enable_ai_coding,
    started_at: item.started_at
  }
}];

const item = $input.first().json;

const codesJson = JSON.stringify(item.all_codes, null, 2);

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are an academic expert in qualitative thematic analysis specialising in: ' + item.domain + '.',
  'You apply rigorous qualitative research methods following ' + item.analysis_method + '.',
  'Your task is to cluster the provided open codes into coherent, higher-order themes.',
  '',
  'RULES:',
  '- Identify between 3 and 7 distinct themes that address the research question.',
  '- Each theme must be grounded in the codes and their verbatim quotations.',
  '- Preserve exact quotations — do not paraphrase.',
  '- Themes must directly address: ' + item.research_question,
  '- Provide a frequency count of how many codes map to each theme.',
  '- Write an overall_finding that synthesises the key insight across all themes.',
  '- Write an analytical_memo reflecting on patterns, tensions, and implications.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema, with no additional commentary:',
  '{',
  '  "document_name": "<filename>",',
  '  "clusters": [',
  '    {',
  '      "theme": "<descriptive theme name>",',
  '      "description": "<2-3 sentence academic description of the theme>",',
  '      "codes": ["<code_name_1>", "<code_name_2>"],',
  '      "supporting_quotes": ["<exact verbatim quote 1>", "<exact verbatim quote 2>"],',
  '      "importance_reasoning": "<why this theme matters for the research question>",',
  '      "frequency": 0',
  '    }',
  '  ],',
  '  "overall_finding": "<synthesised key finding across all themes>",',
  '  "analytical_memo": "<reflective memo on patterns, tensions, and implications>"',
  '}'
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = [
  'Document: ' + item.source_name,
  'Research Question: ' + item.research_question,
  'Total codes to cluster: ' + item.total_codes,
  '',
  'OPEN CODES:',
  codesJson
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    claude_request: {
      model: item.model,
      max_tokens: 4096,
      temperature: 0,
      system: systemPrompt,
      messages: [{
        role: 'user',
        content: userPrompt
      }]
    },
    all_codes: item.all_codes,
    total_codes: item.total_codes,
    source_name: item.source_name,
    research_question: item.research_question,
    analysis_method: item.analysis_method,
    domain: item.domain,
    model: item.model,
    anthropic_api_key: item.anthropic_api_key,
    enable_ai_coding: item.enable_ai_coding,
    started_at: item.started_at,
    step1_completed_at: item.step1_completed_at,
    total_tokens_step1: item.total_tokens_step1,
    step1_errors: item.step1_errors
  }
}];

const item = $input.first().json;

if (!item.enable_ai_coding) {
  // Pass through with empty AI codes so the pipeline continues
  return [{
    json: {
      claude_request: null,
      ai_coding_skipped: true,
      clusters: item.clusters,
      total_themes: item.total_themes,
      overall_finding: item.overall_finding,
      analytical_memo: item.analytical_memo,
      all_codes: item.all_codes,
      total_codes: item.total_codes,
      source_name: item.source_name,
      research_question: item.research_question,
      analysis_method: item.analysis_method,
      domain: item.domain,
      model: item.model,
      anthropic_api_key: item.anthropic_api_key,
      enable_ai_coding: item.enable_ai_coding,
      started_at: item.started_at,
      step1_completed_at: item.step1_completed_at,
      step2_completed_at: item.step2_completed_at,
      total_tokens_step1: item.total_tokens_step1,
      total_tokens_step2: item.total_tokens_step2,
      step1_errors: item.step1_errors
    }
  }];
}

const codesJson = JSON.stringify(item.all_codes, null, 2);

const systemPrompt = [
  'You are an academic expert in AI governance, technology studies, and critical discourse analysis, specialising in: ' + item.domain + '.',
  'Your task is to identify and code AI-specific discourse within the provided qualitative codes.',
  '',
  'DIMENSIONS OF AI DISCOURSE TO ANALYSE:',
  '- technological: references to AI capabilities, systems, algorithms, automation, data, infrastructure',
  '- ethical: AI ethics, bias, fairness, accountability, transparency, human rights, dignity',
  '- societal: social impacts, labour displacement, inequality, power asymmetries, public trust',
  '- geopolitical: AI race dynamics, national strategies, technological sovereignty, great power competition',
  '- governance: regulation, policy, international frameworks, standards bodies, oversight mechanisms',
  '- futures: AI futures discourse, utopian/dystopian narratives, risk, existential concerns, speculative framings',
  '',
  'RULES:',
  '- Only code discourse that is genuinely AI-related — do not stretch interpretations.',
  '- Each AI code must include an exact verbatim quotation from the original codes.',
  '- Assign exactly one dimension per code.',
  '- Provide clear reasoning for the dimension assigned.',
  '- If no AI discourse is present, return an empty ai_specific_codes array.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema, with no additional commentary:',
  '{',
  '  "document_name": "<filename>",',
  '  "ai_specific_codes": [',
  '    {',
  '      "code": "<snake_case_ai_code_name>",',
  '      "description": "<one sentence description of what AI discourse this captures>",',
  '      "quotation": "<exact verbatim quote from the codes>",',
  '      "dimension": "<technological|ethical|societal|geopolitical|governance|futures>",',
  '      "reasoning": "<why this exemplifies AI discourse in the assigned dimension>"',
  '    }',
  '  ],',
  '  "ai_discourse_summary": "<paragraph summarising the AI discourse patterns found in the document>"',
  '}'
].join('\n');

const userPrompt = [
  'Document: ' + item.source_name,
  'Research Question: ' + item.research_question,
  'Domain: ' + item.domain,
  'Total codes to analyse for AI discourse: ' + item.total_codes,
  '',
  'OPEN CODES FROM STEP 1:',
  codesJson
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    claude_request: {
      model: item.model,
      max_tokens: 3000,
      temperature: 0,
      system: systemPrompt,
      messages: [{
        role: 'user',
        content: userPrompt
      }]
    },
    ai_coding_skipped: false,
    clusters: item.clusters,
    total_themes: item.total_themes,
    overall_finding: item.overall_finding,
    analytical_memo: item.analytical_memo,
    all_codes: item.all_codes,
    total_codes: item.total_codes,
    source_name: item.source_name,
    research_question: item.research_question,
    analysis_method: item.analysis_method,
    domain: item.domain,
    model: item.model,
    anthropic_api_key: item.anthropic_api_key,
    enable_ai_coding: item.enable_ai_coding,
    started_at: item.started_at,
    step1_completed_at: item.step1_completed_at,
    step2_completed_at: item.step2_completed_at,
    total_tokens_step1: item.total_tokens_step1,
    total_tokens_step2: item.total_tokens_step2,
    step1_errors: item.step1_errors
  }
}];
